collectibleUnlockChallenges.display_text: Win 10 Encounters with at least a Basic and Vile critter in your squad.
Turn Mana Dice roll Total of at least 7
Spend 100 Mana on Whispsqueak (025) in combat
Heal friendly Bloom or Spirit critters.
Clear 30 dungeons with at least 1 Mechanical critter in your squad.
Turns with at least one active critter afflicted with a status.
Own 2 Tera, 2 Aqua, and 2 Bloom critters.
Afflict enemy critters with Frostbite status.
Own Copper Shield and Spiky Shield.
Any Friendly critter takes Shield damage.
Any Friendly critter deals Shield damage.
Roll 6 or more mana in a single turn.
Roll 13 or more Mana in a single turn.
Deal damage to any enemy Critter.
Afflict Decay on an enemy 50 times.
Knock out Middle Stage or Final Stage critters.
Stun enemy critters with friendly critter skills.
Friendly critters stunned by enemy critter skills.
Clear 100 Dungeons with 2 unique Critters: one Frost and one Tera.
Afflict Toxic or Decay statuses on enemy critters.
Any Friendly critter takes Shield damage.

critters.name: Stinglow

critters.description: This critter has probes that can see into the mind of any critters affected with its poison.
critters.name: Neurojel

critters.name: Petala

critters.description: This fairy suppresses enemy health while sustaining their team's health as guided by energy.
critters.name: Belora

critters.description: This fox critter generates enough heat to boil water due to the large amounts of electricity flowing through its body.
critters.name: Ashkit

critters.description: This critter is largely used in kitchens in order to cook as well as charge equipment. It also loves to eat!
critters.name: Ampyre

critters.description: A small earth bear who uses stones to protect itself.
critters.name: Cubble

critters.description: This critter has hardened ice protecting itself and cooling it down from the geothermal energy it stores up in hibernation.
critters.name: Brumbear

critters.description: This behemoth bear is mistaken for large glaciers when it floats on water. It provides sanctuary on its back to other critters out in the wild.
critters.name: Avalursa

critters.description: This hermit crab critter built its own shell out of spare scrap parts. It keeps replacing pieces every time it thinks the shell is not strong enough. If the whole shell is replaced one piece at a time, is it still the same shell?
critters.name: Scrab

critters.description: This critter has a more refined shell than its prior stage, with reinforced pincers to crush enemies.
critters.name: Shellter

critters.description: This large fortress resides within the shell of a huge hermit crab shell. While these crabs are very large, they mind their own business and are very friendly.
critters.name: Crabastion

critters.description: Emberay soars using heat ribbons that absorb volcanic thermals. These living membranes glow with stored heat and shift like flowing silk.
critters.name: Emberay

critters.description: Solanta has six main heat membranes that flow freely, allowing it to glide for miles without tiring. Within them, networks of living capillaries store and release heat. The patterns shift with mood and temperature.
critters.name: Solanta

critters.description: Smilume is a mask that is inhabited by a spirit that mourns the loss of its own body. It was once a happy critter, though it does not know what kind.
critters.name: Smilume

critters.description: This evolution critter conjures up a second mask made of pure spectral energy which is generated from all of the sorrow it feels. It yearns for companionship and artificially creates it for itself.
critters.name: Grimgaze

critters.description: This critter finally regains courage and strength, forgetting about its sorrowful ways, it once again makes a third mask which is incredibly strong and emits a terrifying aura, frightening all critters it comes into contact with. This does slightly dishearten it still, as it still wants companionship.
critters.name: Trimourn

critters.description: Gromph is a large marsh toad that hides in muddy water, providing the lush overgrowth all over it nutrients through its skin.
critters.name: Gromph

critters.description: Ottice is a small icy otter with hard ice crystals extending from its fur. They dive deep into the arctic to find any growing vegetation or small prey.
critters.name: Ottice

critters.description: Chillter is a sleek otter with sharp claws. They eat fish and vegetation, and they are able to cut through enemies with their sharp icy whiskers.
critters.name: Chillter

critters.description: Frosker is able to swim rapidly in frozen waters, using its ice spines to steer itself and cut through sheets of ice. They can pick up balls of water by creating an icy film around it to play with.
critters.name: Frosker

rollcasters.description: Roland is a young Rollcaster who aims to energize his squad through aggressive tactics. He loves to spar and train through powerful attacks.
rollcasters.name: Roland

rollcasters.description: Pippa is a Rollcaster who hardens the squad for strategic defense, she prefers critters to be strong and absorb blows. Her first lesson is always about how to maintain a strong guard.
rollcasters.name: Pippa

rollcasters.description: Chance is a Rollcaster who designs his own dice, sometimes to gain an unfair advantage. He has great knowledge of Rollcaster history and trained under one of the most renowned dice makers in the world.
rollcasters.name: Chance

rollcasters.description: Doc practices critter medicine, always using advanced tech to help keep all critters healthy. Volta sometimes helps build new machines that Doc designs for his practice.
rollcasters.name: Doc

rollcasters.description: Orson is a mountaineer who climbs in frozen tundras, looking after Frost and Tera critters. He finds them the most intriguing, and always aims to protect and nurture them.
rollcasters.name: Orson

rollcasters.description: Volta is skilled in all mechanical and electrical repairs. She is very friendly to all Mechanical and Thunder critters for this reason, treating them as skilled peers rather than pets.
rollcasters.name: Volta

rollcasters.description: Juni is the youngest member of the Rollcasters, however she is not the newest member. She loves critters who have yet to evolve, nurturing them and making them even stronger, sometimes even surpassing the strength of their evolved forms. Her older brother Foster joined at the same time as her.
rollcasters.name: Juni

rollcasters.description: Foster unlocked an ability only explainable by the magic of the Rollcaster world, and no scientist has been able to figure it out. He has always loved nature, and the Basic critters who lived there, and some think that his connection to these simpler critters helped to unlock this power. His younger sister is Juni.
rollcasters.name: Foster

rollcasters.description: Koa is a young man who fell in love with Vile and Spirit critters at a young age. He found them fascinating, and does not find their harmful poisons or spiritual energy scary. Instead, he looks to find useful applications for them, focusing on things that benefit all critters.
rollcasters.name: Koa

rollcasters.description: Draven is a senior member of the Rollcasters. He often finds himself in ancient ruins, looking into the history of critters and people who lived there. He likes Ancient and Air critters, still fascinated by them as he sees them roam the land or sky.
rollcasters.name: Draven

rollcasters.description: Garron is a shields specialist, and has developed many relics such as the Shield Projector. He ensures all friendly critters are protected in combat, as he saw many injuries when he was younger, and wanted to work his hardest to prevent them to his friends.
rollcasters.name: Garron
